proves.claim: with landing.ledgerMainReds on, offerPulledLanding prepares no test_result statement while its board write lock is held

cli.io-landing-pull.ledger-outside-offer.why: Without it the offer read every ledger row under the board write lock, holding it 10 to 190 s while every other seat got BOARD_BUSY.

proves.claim: with a red ledger row seeded at a commit, the offered land job carries the same mainReds pair as when the read ran inside the lock

cli.io-landing-pull.ledger-main-reds-unc.why: Without it moving the ledger read out of the lock could change which main reds a landing job carries.

proves.claim: with 200,000 test_result rows seeded and ledgerMainReds on, the offer's board-writes.jsonl hold row records heldMs under 1000

cli.io-landing-pull.offer-hold-under-1s.why: Without it a large ledger stretched every landing offer's board write hold past a second.
